maya: Postmortem follow-up for INC-5423 (KV-cache evictions). We agreed we need: concrete triage checklist, exact mitigation commands, and a clear escalation ladder. Please claim items + ETA.
sanjay: I'll handle the triage checklist and the exact commands. ETA Thu 2026-03-26.
tess: I can validate commands in staging once posted.
ev an: I'll draft the escalation wording: page infra after 3 eviction signatures in 24h or p99 delta >200ms. ETA Fri 2026-03-27.
ops-bot: Linked ticket created INF-7891 for runbook updates and remediation sprint.
luca: I'll reserve 2 dev-days in next sprint for runbook validation and PR review.
sanjay: Commands to include in runbook: 
```kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-runtime --since=30m | grep -i "KVCache"
POD=$(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl -n inference exec -it $POD -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sS localhost:9090/debug/cache/evict"```
maya: Add these under runbook -> triage -> collect-evidence and runbook -> mitigate -> force-evict. Also include a rollback note if evict causes errors.
sanjay: Ran the flow in staging; no regressions. Opening PR now.
(48h)
sanjay: PR merged: https://git.redwood/runbooks/commit/ab12cd  runbook updated with checklist, commands, and quick mitigations. INF-7891 updated to status: in-review -> done.
maya: Nice. Next follow-up: add an automated monitor for "3 evictions in 24h" that creates a ticket and pages infra. Evan, can you spike that?
ev an: Spiking alert in Datadog, will post results next week.
luca: Confirming runbook edits merged and sprint time used. Marking postmortem follow-ups closed pending alert spike. :white_check_mark:
